Example: showcase

56 lines · 2 signal(s) · 1 RPC function(s) · route /

from pyweb import App, server

app = App()

@server
def search_products(q: str) -> str:
    return q

@app.page("/")
def Home():
    count = 0
    q = ""
    price = 100
    quantity = 2
    total = price * quantity

    def increment():
        count += 1

    def reset():
        count = 0

    <main class="wrap">
        <nav class="nav">
            <span class="logo">PyWeb</span>
            <span class="tag">Python from browser to database</span>
        </nav>
        <section class="hero">
            <h1>One language. Every layer.</h1>
            <p>Plain Python variables become reactive state. No useState, no fetch, no API routes.</p>
        </section>
        <section class="card">
            <h2>Reactive counter</h2>
            <button onclick={increment} class="btn">
                Count: {count}
            </button>
            <button onclick={reset} class="btn ghost">
                Reset
            </button>
            <p class="hint">Signal count updates only its own text node. No virtual DOM.</p>
        </section>
        <section class="card">
            <h2>Computed value</h2>
            <p>Total {total}</p>
            <p class="hint">total = price * quantity is a Computed node. Only its text node updates.</p>
        </section>
        <section class="card">
            <h2>Two-way binding + server RPC</h2>
            <input bind={q} placeholder="Search products..." />
            <p>Type to filter locally. Server echoes it back:</p>
            <p class="echo">Query: {q}</p>
        </section>
        <footer class="foot">
            <span>Built with PyWeb. SSR HTML plus a tiny signals runtime.</span>
        </footer>
    </main>

import { sig, computed, bind_text, bind_input, on, rpc, mutate, liveList, liveIf, takeover, dynText } from './runtime.js';

export const count = sig(0); // pyweb:count
export const q = sig(""); // pyweb:q
const price = 100; // pyweb:const
const quantity = 2; // pyweb:const
export const total = computed(() => (price * quantity)); // deps price,quantity
export function increment(e) { count(count() + 1) } // pyweb-line:17
export function reset(e) { count(0) } // pyweb-line:20
async function search_products(q) {
  return rpc('search_products', {q});
} // rpc:search_products pyweb-line:6
window.__pyweb_scope = { count, increment, q, reset, total };
export function mount(root=document) {
  // static — no bindings
  // static — no bindings
  // static — no bindings
  // static — no bindings
  // static — no bindings
  on(root, 'click', increment, 'pw00001'); // line 34
  bind_text(root, "count", () => (count())); // line 35
  on(root, 'click', reset, 'pw00002'); // line 37
  // static — no bindings
  // static — no bindings
  // static — no bindings
  bind_text(root, "total", () => (total)); // line 44
  // static — no bindings
  // static — no bindings
  bind_input(root, "q", 'pw00003'); // line 49
  // static — no bindings
  bind_text(root, "q", () => (q())); // line 51
  // static — no bindings
}
if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => mount(document));
  } else { mount(document); }
}

Placement:
increment → browser event handler reachable from UI, browser-safe deps
reset → browser event handler reachable from UI, browser-safe deps
count → browser reactive UI state read by markup, mutated by events
q → browser reactive UI state read by markup, mutated by events
total → browser pure derivation of ['price', 'quantity'], all inputs local
__page__ → browser+server SSR initial HTML on server, activation in browser
